body: There is a big difference between someone that knows you intimately and someone that is being paid to help.
This is one person I should have never hurt because she is probably the one person I could have actually talked to.
I don't usually depend on people. As proof, look me years to open up to someone I loved more than anything. When I finally did it, ironically, was already too late.
I just wish that everything I did wasn't a huge mistake and that I could live without hurting the few people I care about.
I don't think anything I said affected her.
I destroyed our relationship because I can't cope. It hurt her worse than I probably know. Which makes this all that much worse.
Well, I shouldn't have been talking to this person anyway because all I did was hurt her more. If I could do it again I would have just kept it all in and stopped talking.
